tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open remote jobs that can be done from anywhere in the world. All filters are optional; with no filters it returns the newest jobs. Results are sorted newest first and include salary when the employer published one.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details of one job: description, salary, benefits, experience level, dates, and its remotenomadjobs.com job page, where the application is made. Accepts the id from search_jobs or a remotenomadjobs.com job URL.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find employers that currently have open work-from-anywhere jobs, by name. With no query, returns the companies with the most open jobs.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: A company's profile on Remote Nomad Jobs: what it does, how many work-from-anywhere jobs it has open, its main job categories, and its newest open jobs.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: Valid values for the search_jobs filters: job categories, employment types, and perks.
